prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure green (#00FF00) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the man of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the man of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. He has these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the dark iron crown-helm ringed with short iron spikes like flames, with no horns; (2) the very full, untrimmed dark beard going grey, reaching his chest; (3) the dark iron pauldrons engraved with coiled flame sigils; (4) the mantle of soot-black feathers over the shoulders; (5) the pale crack-like scar down the left cheek; (6) the jagged single-bit dark iron axe. Paint them in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right); do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure green (#00FF00) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no green anywhere on the figures: no green cloth, no green glow, no green reflections. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
